contact.basis: Source elevation sampled at the published museum story pin near the public central forecourt.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed original Bangkok National Museum site-context frame with explicitly approximate component registration. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM. A 2 m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.
Composite source relief contains effects from buildings, tree cover and nearby river levels. Precise historical ground contact is an estimate.
